crossBorderLaw.title: Cross-border law
crossBorderLaw.description: In case of joint procurement, the public procurement legislation that applies to the procedure.

legalBasis.title: Legal basis
legalBasis.description: The laws and regulations that govern the contracting process and grant legal authority to the procuring entity.

scheme.title: Scheme
scheme.description: The identifier scheme from which the legislation's identifier is taken.

id.title: ID
id.description: The legislation's identifier taken from the scheme.

uri.title: URI
uri.description: A URI to uniquely identify the legislation.

wasDerivedFrom.title: Was derived from
wasDerivedFrom.description: The law or regulation that the legislation transposes, updates or builds upon. For example, in the EU, some national legislation transposes EU directives.
